trials.title: Spot the Right if Spell!
trials.storyPrompt: Welcome to Cinder Cavern! In Python, a **Boolean** is a value that is either `True` or `False` (always capitalized, no quotes!). An `if` statement checks whether a condition is `True` and runs the indented code underneath. Two golden rules: (1) put a colon `:` at the end of the `if` line, and (2) indent lines inside by 4 spaces. Tap the ONE valid Python `if` spell below!
trials.objective: Choose the valid Python `if` statement that has both a colon `:` and 4-space indentation.
trials.codeSnippet:
heat = 80
# Which if-statement below is valid Python?

choices.label: Option A
choices.explanation: Close! Look at the end of `if heat > 50`—it's missing the colon `:`! Python always needs a `:` at the end of an `if` line.

choices.label: Option B
choices.explanation: Spot on! It has `heat > 50:` with the colon at the end AND 4 spaces of indentation before `shout("Shield up!")`!

choices.label: Option C
choices.explanation: Almost! The colon `:` is there, but `shout("Shield up!")` needs 4 spaces of indentation so Python knows it belongs INSIDE the `if`!

choices.label: Option D
choices.explanation: Tricky! One `=` puts a value into a box—it can't compare inside an `if`! Use `>`, `<`, or `==` to compare.

hints.tier1_nudge: Pip points at the two golden rules: 'Check for BOTH a colon `:` at the end of the `if` line AND 4 spaces before `shout(...)`!'
